[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Add an agent_runners chop guard and idle-gate bugyi_chop_ci_watch[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A declarative `inhibit_if: {agent_runners: {max: N}}` chop guard [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exists end to end, and `bugyi_chop_ci_watch` uses it so the chop [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]only runs while no SASE agent holds a runner slot.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]chop_agent_runners_guard.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/chop_agent_runners_guard.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-ko[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-ko/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust agent_runners guard provider[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-guard: add the `agent_runners` guard variant, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`holds_runner_slot` agent snapshot field, the decision and validation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]logic, and config-authority acceptance in `../sase-core`.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Host snapshot, schema, and docs for agent_runners[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]host-guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]host-guard: teach the Python preflight host to build runner-slot agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshots for the new provider, accept it in `sase.schema.json`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]document it, and cover it with tests including count parity.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Guard skips stop consuming run_every cadence[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]guard-cadence[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard-cadence: stop advancing a chop's `run_every` clock when the skip [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]came from an `inhibit_if` guard rather than from the configured trigger,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]so a guarded chop retries on the next tick.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Enable the idle guard on bugyi_chop_ci_watch[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #5FD7AF] xsmall [/bold black on #5FD7AF]
    [#AF87FF]ci-watch-idle[dim] · [dim][/dim]after host-guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ci-watch-idle: add `inhibit_if: {agent_runners: {max: 0}}` to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`ci_watch` chop in the chezmoi-managed config, refresh its description [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]body, and verify the live runtime accepts and honors it.[/#D7D7AF]
